annotations.target_phrase: the Rue Jules Verne, Parisian boulevard simulated beneath orbital dome
annotations.annotation_text: The Rue Jules Verne is Freeside's central commercial promenade: an artificial replica of nineteenth-century Paris complete with cobblestones, sidewalk cafés, and high-fashion boutiques, sheltered under an artificial sky inside an asteroid-hulled spindle.
sources: Brians, Paul. Study Guide for William Gibson: Neuromancer (1984). WSU.

annotations.target_phrase: simulated sunlight, programmed twilight fading to Mediterranean dusk
annotations.annotation_text: The lighting of Freeside is programmed to mimic the diurnal rhythms of the French Riviera, insulating its decadent inhabitants from the unyielding blackness and radiation of cosmic space.
sources: Bukatman, Scott. Terminal Identity. Duke UP, 1993.
